2893-4762-7906-8289.easyPrerequisites:
You control five or more Forests.
Fertilid has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2893-4762-7906-8289.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Forest enters, Thranduil's Company and Roiling Canopy trigger.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Resolve the Roiling Canopy trigger, giving Devoted Druid +3/+3 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2893-4762-7906-8289.notes: Each loop, Devoted Druid will net +1/+1. This can let you gain more {G}, and that {G} can then fetch non-Forest basic lands with Fertilid.

2301-4279-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

107-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2231-4247-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-4247-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1170-2981-5131-7913--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-5131-7913--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Iron Lad.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

1409-1753-3099-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2169-5641-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

104-6823-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-6823-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more counters on it

243-2713-4050-7218.description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {W/B} due to Zirda and removing two counters from it, returning Plague Belcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Plague Belcher enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Plague Belcher, adding {W/B}.
Repeat.

1162-7428.notablePrerequisites: Angelic Enforcer has lifelink and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1162-7428.description:
Deal combat damage using Angelic Enforcer, doubling your life total due to its lifelink.
At the beginning of your end step, Defiling Daemogoth triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you've lost this turn.

620-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
620-3490-7426.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Repeat from step 2.

2097-3525-3809-4917.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two other artifact creatures.
2097-3525-3809-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.
2097-3525-3809-4917.notes: Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.

3259-4460-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-4460-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-4359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-4359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2981-6972-7160.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

4038-5614-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Bighorner Rancher's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

2061-5733-6927.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2061-5733-6927.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Damage Control Crew.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

522-2111-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1374-3499-3626-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3499-3626-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

643-3951-3975-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2438-3086-3175.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U}
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lagrella.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it and Lagrella triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities.

6331-6676.notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
6331-6676.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Demonic Pact to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.

390-2781.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Hulking Metamorph.
390-2781.description:
Cast Hulking Metamorph by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Hulking Metamorph enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Hulking Metamorph. Choose to have Hulking Metamorph enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

225-5414-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
225-5414-5531-6621.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-5414-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining triggers.
Repeat from step 1.

277-1479-4677-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-4677-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

236-478-804-1460-2821.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
236-478-804-1460-2821.description:
Animate Candelabra using Bring to Life.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-5572-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5572-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1069-1232-1849-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-1849-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

366-2115-2615.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Offspring's Revenge triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a 1/1 copy of it with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Purphoros triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Resolve the Purphoros trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
The opponent whose life total was swapped loses the game due to having zero or les life.

2571-3129-4490-4762.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness and does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2571-3129-4490-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
If Devoted Druid has a +1/+1 counter on it, repeat from step 1 until Devoted Druid has no +1/+1 counters.
Activate Devoted Druid's outlast ability by paying {G} and tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Devoted Druid.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.

893-2089-4067-4435.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Symmetry Matrix, causing you to pay {1} to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Myr Turbine and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.

1300-2816-4387-4992.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls at least five lands.
1300-2816-4387-4992.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Carpet of Flowers triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Carpet of Flowers's ability.
Resolve the copy of Carpet of Flowers's ability, targeting an opponent that controls at least five lands, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

651-3997-4046.description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Task Force has infinite toughness.
Cast Heal the Scars targeting Task Force, gaining life equal to its toughness.
